SELECT FROM metal_product r WHERE r.del_flag='0' AND r.product_code LIKE #{q.codePattern} ESCAPE '!' AND r.product_name LIKE #{q.namePattern} ESCAPE '!' AND r.product_category =#{q.category} AND r.create_time >=#{q.startTime}AND r.create_time <#{q.endExclusive} ORDER BY r.product_id DESC
SELECT FROM metal_product r WHERE r.del_flag='0' AND r.product_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM metal_product r WHERE r.del_flag='0' AND r.product_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE metal_product SET product_code=#{code},product_name=#{name},product_category=#{category},specification=#{specification},dimensions=#{dimensions,typeHandler=com.ruoyi.metal.catalog.DimensionsHandler},volume=#{volume},purity=#{purity},theoretical_weight=#{weight},version=version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW() WHERE product_id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND del_flag='0'
